clue.text: Cross face concealing endless anguish

indicators.note: the word for face hides the shortened anguish inside itself

parts.note: the face of a clock or watch is its dial

indicators.note: endless says the word for anguish loses its final letter

parts.note: agony is extreme anguish

explanation.surface: An angry face hiding unending distress.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cross' looks like the adjective meaning angry, but it is the definition: a line running across from corner to corner.
explanation.definitionFit: A line slanting across from one corner to the opposite one crosses the square, so cross can describe it.

clue.text: Dracula's first count to bite one horribly

indicators.note: to bite says the first letter and count word close around the one, like teeth
first says take just the opening letter of Dracula

parts.note: to count on someone is to rely on them
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Count Dracula sets out to bite someone horribly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'count' suggests the vampire's title but is the verb, as in count on, giving RELY.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something direly means doing it dreadfully or terribly, which is horribly.

clue.text: Fertile land is fit to accommodate golf club

indicators.note: to accommodate says the fit word houses the golf club letters

parts.note: able means fit or capable
the R and A, the Royal and Ancient Golf Club of St Andrews, is golf's governing body

explanation.surface: Fertile land is fit to make room for a golf course.
explanation.walkthrough: The R and A is the Royal and Ancient Golf Club at St Andrews, in Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Arable can be a noun for farmland fit for ploughing and growing crops, that is, fertile land.

clue.text: Secure area inside can below rising smell

indicators.note: below says the can piece sits under the smell piece in the down entry
rising says the smell letters read upwards in this down clue

parts.note: BO, body odour, is a smell

indicators.note: inside says the area letter goes within the can word

parts.note: a tin is a can

explanation.surface: Securing a space inside a bin beneath a growing stench.
explanation.definitionFit: To secure something is to get hold of or acquire it, the same as getting it.

clue.text: Sorry answer over record penned by creative

indicators.note: over says the answer letter goes on top in this down clue
penned by says the record is enclosed by the creative word

parts.note: poetic means creative and imaginative
a log is a written record

explanation.surface: A sorry reply to a record written by an artist.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling or showing regret means being remorseful, so sorry and this word share that sense.

clue.text: Gossip airing salacious babble and gossip initially

definitions.text: Gossip airing salacious babble and gossip initially

indicators.note: initially says take the opening letter of each of the preceding words in turn

explanation.surface: A tattler spreading juicy chatter and rumour.
explanation.walkthrough: An all-in-one: the first letters of every word before 'initially' spell the answer, and the whole clue describes such a person.
explanation.definitionFit: A chatterbox who talks endlessly and spreads tittle-tattle is a classic windbag, someone forever airing salacious babble.

clue.text: Stake money on canter for swift runner

indicators.note: on says the stake goes on top of the canter word in this down clue

parts.note: an ante is the stake put up before a poker hand
a lope is an easy canter

explanation.surface: A gambler bets money on a cantering horse, hoping it's swift.
explanation.walkthrough: The racing surface suggests a horse, but the swift runner is an animal of the African plains.
explanation.definitionFit: These deer-like animals, such as gazelles, are known for their speed, so they are fast runners.

clue.text: Troubles during promotion of politician's live debate

indicators.note: promotion of says the hidden letters are read backwards
during says the letters sit inside the run of words politician's live debate

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A politician hits trouble while promoting a live television debate.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'Troubles during' as the definition, but 'during' signals the hidden word, leaving 'Troubles'. 'Promotion of' lifts SLIVEDEB upwards in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: To bedevil is to torment or plague, which is to trouble someone.

clue.text: Lord purchases old cape by George

indicators.note: purchases is read as holds, taking a grip, so the Lord word holds the old letter

parts.note: the Lord is God
a ness is a headland or cape, as in Loch Ness's neighbouring place names

explanation.surface: A lord buys an old cloak from a man called George.
explanation.walkthrough: 'purchases' means grips, as in getting a purchase on something. 'By George' is an exclamation of surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are old-fashioned exclamations of surprise, used interchangeably as a mild oath.

clue.text: Backlash from Establishment with Conservative moving right

indicators.note: moving right says the letter for Conservative shifts further along to the right inside the word

parts.note: creation is the establishing or founding of something

explanation.surface: A political backlash against the Establishment as a Tory shifts rightwards.
explanation.walkthrough: The C at the front of CREATION moves rightward to sit after REA. 'Moving right' reads as a political shift, but it is a letter move.
explanation.definitionFit: A reaction is a response pushing back against something, which is what a backlash is.

clue.text: Macho man's perfect score pad

parts.note: a stud is a virile, macho man
10 is a perfect score, written as the letters I and O

explanation.surface: A macho man's pad earns a perfect ten.
explanation.walkthrough: The figure 10 is read as the letters IO.
explanation.definitionFit: A pad is a small flat or apartment, and a studio is a one-room flat.

clue.text: Sweet tablet twisted into spiral

indicators.note: into says the turned tablet goes inside the word for spiral

parts.note: a loop is a coil or spiral

indicators.note: twisted says the word for tablet is turned round end to end

parts.note: a pill is a tablet of medicine

explanation.surface: A sugary tablet twisted into a spiral shape, like a swirly candy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sweet' is the British word for a piece of candy; the surface's spiral pictures the swirled pattern on such a treat.
explanation.definitionFit: A lollipop is a hard candy on a stick, a type of confectionery, which the British call a sweet.

clue.text: Scruff's shameful empty cooker

indicators.note: empty says the word shameful has all its inner letters removed, leaving only its ends

parts.note: an oven is a cooker

explanation.surface: A scruffy person's shamefully unused cooker.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words name an untidy, slovenly person who does not care about appearance.

clue.text: Performed save oddly in sharp cross

indicators.note: in says the performed and odd letters go inside the sharp word

parts.note: terse means curt or sharp
ran means operated or performed, as a machine ran

indicators.note: oddly says take the odd-numbered letters of save

explanation.surface: A goalkeeper made an odd save from a sharp cross.
explanation.walkthrough: The football surface makes 'cross' a pass into the box, but it means lying across.
explanation.definitionFit: Transverse means lying or extending across something, crosswise.

clue.text: Container harbour over on Middle East city

indicators.note: over says the container and harbour words together are turned back to front

parts.note: a silo is a storage container for grain
a port is a harbour

explanation.surface: A container port somewhere in a Middle Eastern city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Container harbour' reads as one phrase, a container port, but splits into two pieces that 'over' turns round together.
explanation.definitionFit: A metropolis is a large, important city, especially a region's chief urban centre.

clue.text: Unbending hand not pulling any punches

definitions.meaning: in poker, five cards in sequence

explanation.surface: A rigid hand delivers its blows at full force.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means level or rigid, names a poker sequence, and describes candid, direct talk.

clue.text: Shell swiftly supporting Ferrari?

indicators.note: supporting says the swiftly word sits beneath the car in this down clue

parts.note: a Ferrari is an example of a car, hence the question mark
apace means swiftly

explanation.surface: A shell that speeds along under a Ferrari.
explanation.definitionFit: A carapace is the hard shell on the back of a tortoise, crab or similar creature.

clue.text: Abiding vessel emitting revolting content

indicators.note: revolting means turning back, so the held letters run upwards in this down clue
content says the letters are held within vessel emitting

explanation.surface: A lasting container giving off a disgusting filling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolting' looks like disgusting but means turning over, and 'content' is what is held inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Something abiding lasts forever and never dates, the same as being eternal.

clue.text: Square beam's ignoring advanced practices

parts.note: a T-square is a drawing tool, so T can stand for square

indicators.note: ignoring says one letter A is left out of the word for beams

parts.note: radiation is a beam of energy; the 's adds an S

explanation.surface: A square beam, with no advanced techniques, in a carpentry workshop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ignoring' drops the second A of the beam word, not the first. Beam is also the setter's name, which helps disguise the word.
explanation.definitionFit: Traditions are customs or established ways of doing things, which are practices.

clue.text: Relatively bold supporter on about victory reversed

indicators.note: on says the supporter goes above the next piece in this down clue

parts.note: a bra is a supporting undergarment

indicators.note: reversed says about plus victory are turned round

parts.note: re means about, concerning
V is for victory

explanation.surface: A relatively bold supporter cheers a victory turned around.
explanation.definitionFit: Relatively bold means bolder by comparison, the comparative form, so more courageous.

clue.text: Tramps round in house top mostly

indicators.note: in says the round letter goes inside the other pieces
mostly says the top word loses its last letter

parts.note: best means top, as in to best someone
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: Tramps wander round inside a house, mostly on the top floor.
explanation.definitionFit: Hoboes are homeless itinerant wanderers, which tramps also are.

clue.text: Finish with one shilling to last, they believe

indicators.note: to last says that letter moves to the very end

parts.note: to desist is to stop or finish doing something
S was the abbreviation for a shilling, an old British coin, and one of the word's two S letters moves

explanation.surface: Believers finish by putting one shilling into the collection.
explanation.walkthrough: A shilling was a British coin worth a twentieth of a pound, abbreviated S.
explanation.definitionFit: Deists believe in a creator god who does not intervene in the world, so they are believers.

clue.text: Stimulate knowledge following a detailed method

indicators.note: following says the knowledge word comes after the other pieces
detailed is read as de-tailed, so the method word loses its last letter

parts.note: a way is a method of doing something
ken is knowledge or range of understanding

explanation.surface: Arousing interest in knowledge by following a detailed method.
explanation.walkthrough: 'detailed' looks like 'thorough' but means de-tailed: WAY loses its tail, Y.
explanation.definitionFit: To awaken feelings or interest is to rouse or stir them, which is to stimulate.

clue.text: All time sweetheart keeping pure

indicators.note: keeping says the time and sweetheart letters hold the pure word inside them

parts.note: an eon is a vast period of time
very in the sense of the very thing means pure, sheer
the heart of the word sweet is its middle letter E

explanation.surface: An everlasting sweetheart who stays pure.
explanation.walkthrough: The pure word is used as in 'the very truth', meaning sheer; it sits between the two parts of the time piece.
explanation.definitionFit: All people taken together is everybody, the same as saying all.

clue.text: Attack ends of extensive beard

parts.note: to go at someone is to attack them

indicators.note: ends of says take the first and last letters of extensive

explanation.surface: Taking on a sprawling beard.
explanation.definitionFit: A goatee is a small pointed tuft of hair on the chin, a type of beard.

clue.text: Prior is religious title acquired by religious …

indicators.note: acquired by says the title is taken inside the word for religious

parts.note: pious means devoutly religious
Rev, short for Reverend, is a clergy title

explanation.surface: A monastery prior holds a religious title won by a devout person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prior' looks like the monastic rank, fitting the religious surface, but it is the adjective meaning earlier. The ellipsis runs on into the next clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Something previous came before, earlier in time or order, which is what prior means as an adjective.

clue.text: … belief. It's finished taking His Eminence's Mass

indicators.note: finished points to the finish, the last letter, of the word It

parts.note: HE is the abbreviation for His Eminence, a cardinal's title; the 's stands for is

explanation.surface: Following on from the previous clue, a religious belief is done once a cardinal takes Mass.
explanation.walkthrough: The setter confirmed this parse: T, the finish of It, then HE plus 'S read as IS, then M; 'taking' just joins them.
explanation.definitionFit: Theism is the belief that a god or gods exist, a religious creed.

clue.text: Poles accepting currency's current instability

indicators.note: accepting says the poles take the currency and current letters between them

parts.note: N and S are the north and south poles
the euro is a currency, with the 's giving euros
I is the symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: Poles who take euros now face instability.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Poles' seems to mean people from Poland, but it gives N and S.
explanation.definitionFit: A neurosis is a mental disorder marked by anxiety, a kind of emotional instability.
